name: Button & Chico in: A Game of Cat and Mouse
source:
A short visual novel about Button the Mouse and Chico the Cat. 

Follow their summer story after they meet during high school graduation, and get to experience details about their unusual families, frantic private life and how it all ties back music.

[Edited from [url=https://dogfolder.itch.io/button-and-chico]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
关于老鼠巴顿和猫奇科的短篇视觉小说。

跟随他们在高中毕业期间相遇后的夏季故事，体验他们不寻常的家庭、疯狂的私人生活以及这一切如何与音乐联系的细节。

[编辑自[url=https://dogfolder.itch.io/button-and-chico]itch.io[/url]]
